identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study Comparing MB02 and Avastin® in Subjects With Stage IIIB/IV Non-Squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Multicenter, Multinational, Double-Blind Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of MB02 (Bevacizumab Biosimilar Drug) Versus Avastin® in Combination With Carboplatin and Paclitaxel for the Treatment of Subjects With Stage IIIB/IV Non-squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

interventions.name: MB02 (Bevacizumab Biosimilar Drug)
interventions.description: 15 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks on Day 1

interventions.name: EU-approved Avastin®
interventions.description: 15 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks on Day 1

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: Carboplatin Area under the curve (AUC) 6 IV every 3 weeks on Day 1 for 6 cycles

interventions.name: Paclitaxel
interventions.description: Paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 IV every 3 weeks on Day 1 for 6 cycles
